criteria.interpretation: Median run-level outcomes for each deployment; useful work includes queue and scheduling delay. Short-burst improvement is tested separately from sustained overload. Caller-deadline failures are deliberately induced and shown, not silently removed.

methodology.scope: Local real-PostgreSQL comparison, not production capacity or a starvation guarantee.
methodology.traffic: Open-loop, no retries, 60/20/20 services, 80% critical. Responses and all execution/waiters/SQL drain between phases; controller state survives. Client20ms deadline phase intentionally produces deadline errors. Useful critical responses must finish within100ms of schedule including queue and dispatch.
methodology.selection: Exploratory runs may inform implementation; this report records a subsequent fixed-code repeated matrix.
